## Done so far
The CLI bundles @sati/*. The installed command is ~/.local/lib/sati and no longer uses this repo's dist. Test, changeset and progress note are written. Not committed.

## Next step
When the machine has free memory, run pnpm build && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm knip && pnpm test from the repo root, then commit the bundle fix and the PLAN.md WP9 tick, and push to main.
